sources.title: LocaLLM - Private AI in your desktop browser, no account
sources.snippet: AI for the work you can't paste into ChatGPT. Summarize contracts, client notes, and research on your own machine in a desktop Chrome or Edge tab. Local chats and local documents stay on-device, and you can verify the expected network requests. Enforced, not promised. The browser blocks unexpected exfiltration; model downloads, web search, cloud keys, and local servers are explicit and visible ...
